analysis.title: Persistent tech pressures underline need for portfolio resilience
key_insights: Tech sold off hard on Friday. Nasdaq 100 fell 5.6% and the S&P 500 fell 3.7%, its seventh straight daily decline. Nasdaq is 19.8% below its 6 October high and the S&P 500 is down 11.5%, in correction territory.
US 10-year yield fell 10bp to 4.95% as Treasuries rallied. VIX reached nearly 36, the highest since the April 2025 Liberation Day tariff turmoil.

Selling reflects doubts over AI infrastructure spending sustainability given physical and financing constraints and whether AI revenues justify the investment. NVIDIA leadership transition and a WSJ report of an SEC civil probe added uncertainty.

Markets price a near-100% probability of a 25bp Fed hike in December, with further tightening expected in Q1 2027. Hawkish Fed communications and October minutes flagged concern about broadening US inflation.

Gold fell to a 14-month low of USD 3,532 an ounce and was down about 9% on the week on higher real rates, a stronger dollar and possible liquidation to cover losses. Copper had its steepest weekly fall since April 2025.

UBS views the sell-off as largely positioning-led ahead of the short US Thanksgiving week. Base case for 2027 is near-trend growth, rising earnings, higher AI investment and moderating inflation later in the year.
UBS recently downgraded global equities from Attractive to Neutral on elevated expectations, concentrated indexes and AI monetization uncertainty. The week's volatility supports that decision.
Cumulative US tech AI infrastructure investment could near USD 5tr by end-2028. UBS estimates AI model and application revenues need to reach at least USD 1.5tr by 2030 for an adequate return.
UBS sees few near-term catalysts to lift equities and expects volatility to stay elevated. It advises disciplined rebalancing, diversification and maintaining shopping and disposal lists.

Year Ahead views: about 15% 2027 earnings growth in US and Eurozone, Eurozone preferred region, favor industrials and health care, US equal-weight to cut tech concentration. In AI favor strong hyperscalers and selected compute, foundry, semicap and infrastructure software names.
Structured strategies may help investors generate income or participate when implied volatility is elevated, with capital-loss, issuer and liquidity risks.
Gold decline attributed to real yields, dollar and liquidity, not a loss of diversification role. UBS forecasts gold at USD 5,000 by December 2027 and prefers copper among industrial metals.

Alibaba Q3 cloud revenue grew 53% y/y with external cloud above 60% and margin about 14.5%. Tencent cloud growth was about 35% y/y with a second straight quarter of negative free cash flow. UBS favors onshore semiconductor equipment, foundries and hardware benefiting from AI chip localization.

earnings_insights: Alibaba reported Q3 cloud revenue growth of 53% y/y, external cloud revenue up more than 60% y/y, and cloud margin of roughly 14.5% vs below 10% two quarters earlier.

Tencent said cloud growth accelerated to around 35% y/y, with a second consecutive quarter of negative free cash flow. Management said spending is near a quarterly peak but may stay elevated for several quarters.
